extracted.intended_audience: Public company registrants and their legal, finance, investor-relations, sustainability, and audit teams (companies subject to SEC reporting)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and filing SEC-mandated climate-related disclosures (Regulation S‑K and S‑X) for registrants in accordance with the SEC’s final Climate-Related Disclosure rule. Covers what to disclose, how to present it, assurance and tagging requirements, and phased compliance dates by filer type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope 3 disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope 3: Eliminating Scope 3 disclosures for all registrants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key change from the proposed rule—registrants are not required to disclose Scope 3 emissions under the final rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality and disclosure thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the standard materiality definition, with a specific disclosure threshold for the financial statement disclosures; The use of the 1% threshold has been significantly limited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule uses standard materiality; specific thresholds apply for certain financial statement disclosures. The 1% threshold’s use has been significantly limited; certain disclosures (e.g., severe weather-related financial impacts) remain subject to a one percent and de minimis thresholds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Limiting disclosure requirements to Large Accelerated Filers and Accelerated Filers and only when those emissions are material; Exempting Smaller Reporting Companies and Emerging Growth Companies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scope 1 and 2 disclosures are required for LAFs and AFs when material. SRCs and EGCs are exempt from the Scope 1/2 disclosure requirements under the final rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability (which registrants are covered)
rubrics_metrics.description: Public companies with reporting obligations pursuant to the Securities Exchange Act Section 13(a) or Section 15(d), and companies filing a Securities Act or Exchange Act registration statement (registrants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule applies to registrants filing registration statements and Exchange Act annual reports; compliance is phased in by filer status (Large Accelerated, Accelerated, Small Reporting Company, Emerging Growth Company, Non‑Accelerated Filer) with different FYB dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance — Board oversight of climate-related risks
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify any board committee or subcommittee responsible for the oversight of climate-related risks and describe the processes by which the board or such committee or subcommittee is informed about such risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also describe whether and how the board of directors oversees progress against disclosed climate-related targets, goals, or transition plans. Disclose the responsible committee(s) and the processes used to inform the board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management oversight and responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe management's role in assessing and managing material climate-related risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose applicable management positions or committees responsible for assessing and managing climate-related risks, the relevant expertise of position holders or committee members, the processes by which they assess/manage such risks, and whether they report information about climate-related risks to the board or a board committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy, business model, and outlook disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe climate-related risks that have materially impacted or are reasonably likely to have a material impact on the strategy, results of operations, or financial condition, with impacts described over the short-term (next 12 months) and long-term (beyond the next 12 months).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must state whether risks are physical or transitional; describe actual and potential material impacts on strategy/business model/outlook and the relevant time frame; state whether impacts have been integrated into strategy or business model; provide quantitative and qualitative descriptions of material expenditures and material impacts on financial estimates and assumptions directly resulting from mitigation/adaptation activities. Include activities to mitigate or adapt, such as transition plans (with metrics and targets), scenario analysis (scenarios considered and potential financial impacts), and internal carbon pricing (price per metric ton CO2e, total price, and how total price is estimated to change over time).

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk management processes for climate-related risks
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any existing processes for identifying, assessing, and managing material climate-related risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include how the organization identifies whether it has incurred or is likely to incur a material physical or transition risk; how it decides to mitigate, accept, or adapt to a risk; how it prioritizes which risks to address; and whether/how these processes are integrated into the company’s overall risk management system or processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targets and goals disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any climate-related target or goal if such target or goal has materially affected or is reasonably likely to materially affect the registrant's business, results of operations, or financial condition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose progress toward meeting the target/goal and how progress was achieved, including material expenditures and material impacts on financial estimates and assumptions that directly result from the target/goal or actions taken to meet it. Note that target/goal disclosures may be included within Strategy or Risk Management disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carbon offsets and Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose use of carbon offsets or RECs when they have been used as a material component of a registrant's plan to achieve climate-related targets or goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If offsets/RECs were used as a material component, disclose the aggregate amount expensed, aggregate capitalized carbon offsets and RECs recognized, aggregate losses incurred on capitalized offsets/RECs, and aggregate recoveries recognized during the fiscal year. Disclosures required only if offsets/RECs were material components of plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: GHG emissions metrics and methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: For Large Accelerated Filers and Accelerated Filers, disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions if such emissions are material; disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions separately, each expressed in the aggregate in terms of CO2e and in gross terms, excluding the impact of any purchased or generated offsets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also disclose any constituent gas of the disclosed emissions that is material. Describe the methodology, significant inputs, and significant assumptions used to calculate the disclosed GHG emissions. Reasonable estimates may be used provided the registrant describes the underlying assumptions and reasoning for the estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Severe weather events and other natural‑condition impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose capitalized costs, expenditures expensed, charges, and losses incurred as a result of severe weather events and other natural conditions (e.g., hurricanes, flooding, drought, wildfires, sea level rise).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such disclosures are subject to applicable one percent and certain de minimis thresholds. Disclose separately any recoveries recognized during the fiscal year as a result of severe weather events for which costs/expenditures/charges/losses are disclosed. If estimates and assumptions used in financial statements were materially impacted by risks and uncertainties associated with severe weather events or disclosed climate-related targets/transition plans, provide a qualitative description of how those estimates/assumptions were impacted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation and electronic tagging requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: File climate-related disclosures in registration statements and Exchange Act annual reports; provide Regulation S‑K climate-related disclosures either in a separate, appropriately captioned section of the filing or in another appropriate section (e.g., Risk Factors, Description of Business, MD&A) or by incorporation by reference as long as the disclosure meets electronic tagging requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronically tag both narrative and quantitative climate-related disclosures in Inline XBRL. Financial statement disclosures under Article 14 must be tagged in accordance with existing rules pertaining to financial statement tagging (see Rule 405(b)(1)(i) of Regulation S‑T).

rubrics_metrics.name: Safe harbor for certain climate-related forward‑looking information
rubrics_metrics.description: The final rules provide a safe harbor for climate-related disclosures pertaining to transition plans, scenario analysis, the use of an internal carbon price, and targets and goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The safe harbor treats all information required by the specified sections, except for historical facts, as a forward-looking statement (i.e., potentially subject to forward‑looking statement protections/consequences).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance dates and phased implementation by filer type
rubrics_metrics.description: The final rules become effective 60 days after publication in the Federal Register; compliance will be phased-in based on registrant filer status (Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Small Reporting Company, Emerging Growth Company, Non‑Accelerated Filer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule sets specific FYB (fiscal year beginning) dates for different disclosure elements (e.g., S‑K/S‑X disclosures, GHG Scope 1/2 disclosures, assurance milestones, and Inline XBRL tagging). See the rule’s chart for exact FYB years by registrant type (examples: LAFs begin certain disclosures FYB 2025, Scope 1/2 disclosures FYB 2026, limited assurance FYB 2029, reasonable assurance FYB 2033; AFs and SRC/EGC/NAF have later/modified timelines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurance requirements for GHG emissions disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The final rule requires assurance over certain GHG emissions disclosures with phased timelines for limited assurance and, later, reasonable assurance depending on registrant type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assurance obligations (Item 1506 limited and reasonable assurance) are phased in by filer status; limited assurance is required earlier and reasonable assurance at a later FYB for some registrant types. The rule’s timetable indicates different assurance start dates for LAFs, AFs, and exemptions for SRCs/EGCs/NAFs.
